meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 当你要把一个目录、网址、粘贴笔记或刚才的对话变成技能时，Claude 会提炼其中的步骤和踩坑点，在 .claude/skills 下新建或更新 SKILL.md，并告诉你怎么调用。
howto.when: 当你说出“/learn”等指令，或要求把某个来源（如目录、网址等）做成技能时触发；若要改进已有技能，也会接管。

say.text: /learn 这个目录，把它做成技能
say.note: 会读取目录结构，提炼成可复用的操作步骤

say.text: 把刚才一起完成的流程提炼成技能
say.note: 会整理对话中的步骤和坑，生成技能说明文件

say.text: 给已有的 postgres 技能补一条刚才踩的坑
say.note: 会读取原技能文件，就地更新而不是重写

howto.what_en: When you ask to turn a directory, URL, pasted notes, or a recent conversation into a reusable skill, Claude extracts the steps and gotchas, creates or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, and tells you how to invoke it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says '/learn' or asks to distill a source (directory, URL, etc.) into a skill, or to improve an existing skill.

say_en.note: Reads the directory and distills it into a skill.

say_en.text: Turn what we just did into a skill
say_en.note: Re-reads the conversation, extracts steps and gotchas.

say_en.text: Add the gotcha we hit to the existing postgres skill
say_en.note: Reads the current SKILL.md and updates it in place.
